invariants.rationale: The method expects a list of records to insert; null is likely not intended and would cause errors.
instantTime is used to identify the write instant and is passed through to other methods, so it must not be null.
The size of a List in Java is always non-negative, capturing valid collection state.
This expresses the equivalence between isEmpty and size for Lists.
instantTime should be a non-empty, non-blank string representing a moment of write in the system.
